It’s now 13 hours past and back from a whole day’s work, only to be disappointed that I’m still waiting for Mother Gothel to respond. 

But let me lit a little fire to encourage her to respond back to her “Debate Me” (in caps locked) challenge. 

Let’s start with the Universal Healthcare Law. 

Just so it’s not misunderstood:

The groundwork was laid by the Philippine Health Agenda 2016–2022, and the law’s Senate Bills 1458, 1673, 1714, 60 and House Bill 5784 were first filed and refined during Aquino’s term.
Lawmakers like Sen. JV Ejercito, Sen. Risa Hontiveros, and Rep. Angelina Tan pushed it long before Duterte ever touched the paper through Senate Bill 1896 and House bill 5784. This later became RA 11223 and signed into law in February 2019. 

(Highlight: “signed into law” only and no prior ideas or visions expressed by the lazy hand Rodrigo Duterte). Meaning, Duterte merely signed what others had built.

The Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) only got signed October 2019, many months after the law.  See how lazy he was and lacking when it comes to the real welfare needs of Filipinos, Mother Gothel? 

But what should anger you and even every fanatical Duterte supporters is this:

— Out-of-pocket spending remains a heavy burden
— In 2016, around 54.5% of health spending in the Philippines came from out of pocket. That means many Filipinos still pay a lot themselves despite UHC law! 

Why? Because the murderous and corrupt Duterte and his administration prioritised lining up their pockets with hard earned Filipino taxpayers’ money. But this is for the next 4th and 5th items once you respond…

@MotherGothel
